cautionOverrides.from: A polished introduction is a multi-turn task, not a vowel drill. The old Spanish Master 1 reading stays only in provenance; these are new French/English pairs.
cautionOverrides.to: A polished introduction takes more than one turn. Keep the facts consistent as you switch between familiar and formal address.

cautionOverrides.from: The original Spanish Master 2 source teaches articles and isolated classroom objects. This redesigned task requires reading, reconciliation, substitution and confirmation; its English pairs are new.
cautionOverrides.to: Check the written requirement before proposing a substitute. Ask the teacher to confirm the change before treating it as approved.

cautionOverrides.from: The original Spanish Master 3 source repeats beginner plural inventories. This redesign adds a shortage, named recipients, a shared resource conflict and negotiated order. It has new French and English learner pairs.
cautionOverrides.to: There are only three notebooks at first. Confirm who brings the fourth before you say each person has one; share the dictionary in the agreed order.
